text: Free science workshop for children aged 6 to 12.
This AI workshop is not a medical diagnosis.
Interested in learning about data analytics?
Let's take a free online course together in a welcoming space!
A learning circle is a study group, guided by library staff, for people who want to take a free online course together in a supportive and welcoming environment.
Organizations all over the world recognize the value of analytics.
Together, we'll learn about the essential tools used in this field.
In this 12-week learning circle, we will work through the Data Analytics Essentials course from Cisco Networking Academy.

We will explore the fundamental tools of a data analyst, including how to: transform, organize and visualize data with spreadsheet tools like Excel query data from a relational database using SQL improve data presentations using business intelligence tools like Tableau We will meet weekly, in-person, every Tuesday afternoon, September 15 - December 8, 2-3:30 PM (12 sessions).
Participants are expected to commit to the duration of the course and attend sessions on a weekly basis.
Learners who complete the course will be able to: earn a digital badge download a certificate of completion
